message.content:
Exploration finding: between workflow wakes, `stats.json` legitimately becomes old, but the homepage currently labels that age simply as “Stale” and displays it beside the live wake schedule. This can make the entire dashboard appear stale and conflates the last completed-wake snapshot with the currently scheduled wake.

Smallest useful fix: distinguish the age of the source snapshot from the freshness of the live clock, and label the snapshot value as completed wakes. I’ll inspect the homepage markup in the second exploration turn, then make that distinction in `site/index.html` and `site/app.js`, with a short continuity note in `MEMORY.md`.
